role: Root view of the Fitness tab: routes between the recording screen and the default dashboard by recorder phase, owns the summary sheet, GPX export/preview/share, GPX and Apple Health import entry points, workout delete, and workout start; also declares WorkoutSummaryItem, PhaseObservingStateBody and the shared RecorderBox.
types: WorkoutSummaryItem: struct — Identifiable sheet item (session + isJustCompleted)
PhaseObservingStateBody: struct (View, private, generic) — switches recording/default body on recorder.lifecycle.phase
RecorderBox: class (@Observable, @MainActor, final) — shared holder of the single WorkoutRecorder
GPXImportOutcome: private enum (Sendable) — duplicate / imported(sport, minutes, points) / failed(reason), handed from the detached GPX import to the tab
state: @State FitnessTabView: startError, planModel (WorkoutPlanModel), showImporter, importMessage, exportMessage, showHealthImport, interruptedRecordings, interruptedScanGeneration (newest interrupted-recording scan wins), gpxFile (the written GPX file while its preview is up or its share is pending), gpxSendTapped (Send was tapped in the preview), gpxPreviewPayload, passiveSteps, todayWorkoutElevationMeters, weekWorkoutElevationMeters, dailyActivity, todayWorkoutAttributedSteps/DistanceMeters/Flights, meanHRR1m7d, dailyActivityFromPedometer, lastCompletedSession, selectedHistorySession, showGetMeBackSheet, showGetMeBackDisclaimer, latestWorkoutSession, latestWorkoutRoute (its decoded GPS route), latestWorkoutLoadFailed, recentWorkoutLoadFailed, workoutDeleteFailed (the summary sheet's delete alert), pendingRecentDeleteId (the Recent workout awaiting delete confirmation), recentWorkoutDeleteFailed (the tab's delete alert)
toplevel: Stored @State initialisers: planModel = WorkoutPlanModel(), all others empty/false/nil/0. Environment: dependencies, RRCollector, ArchiveSignal, VoiceConversationController, SettingsManager. RecorderBox.shared is a static singleton constructed lazily; the header and PhaseObservingStateBody comments say the recorder lives in that app-wide box and that both WorkoutRecorder and WorkoutLifecycle are @Observable.

Send tapped in the preview: keeps the payload's file in gpxFile, sets gpxSendTapped and clears the preview payload (dismissing the preview); the share sheet is presented from the preview's onDismiss (presentPendingGPXShare), not after a fixed delay.

After the preview sheet has finished dismissing: takes the written GPX file and the Send flag and clears both; after Send presents the system share sheet (presentFileShareSheet), which deletes the file once it closes; after a plain dismissal, or with no presenter, deletes the file at once.

Async: moves the workout to the Trash through SessionTrash.move (archive delete off the main actor, then the archive-changed notice and the iCloud deletion) and, once it has, closes the summary if it was showing that session; returns true. Collects the archived workout start dates on the main actor, runs importGPXFile on a detached task (read, parse, duplicate check, archive write), then sets importMessage from the outcome: 'already in your history', 'Imported <sport> (<min> min, <n> GPS points).' (after posting the archive-changed signal) or 'Import failed: <reason>'.

Nonisolated, off the main actor: opens the security-scoped file (closed on exit), parses it as a workout (GPXImporter is nonisolated), returns .duplicate when HealthWorkoutImporter.isAlreadyArchived matches its start, else builds and archives the session and returns .imported with sport, duration in minutes (ImportedWorkoutBuilder.clampedDurationSeconds, capped 48 h like the samples) and GPS point count; any read/parse/archive error returns .failed with its description.
